Remarks

The ray is defined by a point and a direction vector. The collider uses the current transform to determine its position and orientation.

Remarks

Direction

Gets the direction vector of the ray, based on the current rotation.

public Vector2 Direction { get; }

Property Value

Vector2

Remarks

The direction is calculated from the current transform's rotation in radians.
